geographic.reviewStatus: signed medium-fi mapped tower and primary north-up context; approximate northwest frontage
geographic.orientationConfidence: exact-QID outline; primary plans corroborate axes; northwest canopy is contextual reconstruction
geographic.notes: Fresh exact Q1542408 tower way 1179710949, address 2457 Avenida Andrés Bello, supplies the individual 300 m/64-level tower footprint, unchanged from the cached outline within 0.002 m rounding. Keep anchor [-70.606792403,-33.416929353] and heading +0.938147971775: native +X northeast bearing 36.25 degrees and -Z northwest bearing 306.25 degrees. The actually inspected owner floor-60 north arrow and connectivity page-4 north-up map corroborate tower axes and tower northwest of the mall, with Andrés Bello/Mapocho on its northwest side and Nueva Tobalaba northeast. Owner address and independent street access, architect rod-supported ground photo and owner aerial cover support a northwest office-frontage reconstruction; the eight model leaves, centered canopy span and precise offsets are illustrative rather than a north-annotated entrance survey. The additional mapped entrance node 13042181363 is southeast near the tower edge; it is not labelled as the exclusive office entrance and is not silently substituted for the Andrés Bello frontage. The fourfold tower/crown body is rotation-symmetric; the authored northwest canopy is an explicitly approximate frontage, not a claim of sole entry. Source outline and envelope ridge fit are sampled separately, with up to roughly 2 m corner/edge simplification. Mall, adjacent towers, underground levels and actual plaza grade are outside this individual asset.
